title: TM Forum map: eTOM, SID, ODA, Open APIs
concept: TM Forum provides an integrated framework for telecoms. eTOM defines business processes. SID provides a shared data model. Open APIs enable interoperability between systems. ODA packages these into a cloud-native, component-based architecture. Together they create a common language across business, data and technical domains.
why: Your unified framework needs a COBIT-like model for network operations. TM Forum offers that: eTOM is the process map, SID the data dictionary, and Open APIs the integration layer. Understanding how they connect helps you align network governance with IT governance.
question: Which network processes in your organisation could you map to eTOM to create shared accountability between IT and network teams?
